article.headline: Bennett's 15 help Wyoming defeat Regis 95-48
article.description: — Khaden Bennett's 15 points helped Wyoming defeat Regis 95-48 on Tuesday in a season opener for the Cowboys.

event.description: Regis University REGIS UNIVERSITY @ Wyoming Cowboys

keywords: Regis University REGIS UNIVERSITY @ Wyoming Cowboys
article.story: LARAMIE, Wyo. -- — Khaden Bennett's 15 points helped Wyoming defeat Regis 95-48 on Tuesday in a season opener for the Cowboys. Bennett added six rebounds for the Cowboys. Parker Gerrits scored 12 points, shooting 4 for 5, including 2 for 3 from beyond the arc. Nasir Meyer shot 3 of 7 from the field and 4 of 6 from the free-throw line to finish with 11 points. Quinn Lambert led the Rangers in scoring, finishing with seven points and Meto Orji scored six. Wyoming lead for good just 26 seconds into the game. The Cowboys led 42-27 at halftime. Wyoming pulled away with a 24-2 run in the second half to extend a 19-point lead to 41 points. Up next Wyoming plays Friday against Idaho State at home, and Regis visits Northern Colorado on Sunday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
